utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Gus, the repair drive is set for Saturday at the front porch, and I’m still gathering helpers. If you can spread the word, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word and tell folks to come by Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — I really appreciate it. See you Saturday at the front porch!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Since it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, I’ll bring it there and keep it ready and tidy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Eli — that works great. I’ll send you the remaining fixes soon and let you know what’s left to cover.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll wait for the remaining fixes and keep my Sunday plan clear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet—I could still use a few more hands before we can start. It’s this Saturday at the front porch if you can help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help. What time should I be there, and do you still need anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mina — could you come by at 10 a.m.? If you can, bring a screwdriver and some gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — just a quick update, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. Let me know if you want a task to take on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center is much clearer. I can help, but could you send me the start time and what you’d like me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — we’re starting at 10 AM, and if you can help with check-in and sorting donations, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — that’d help a lot. If you can bring those and maybe lend a hand Saturday at the front porch, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I can bring those and help out Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what’s still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. We still need a few basic tools and anyone who can sort parts or greet people at the porch would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just helpers for Saturday at the front porch—if you can spread the word, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll spread the word about that instead.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, got it—Sunday at the community center. Thanks for spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Leo—if you could keep an eye out for extra screwdrivers or tape, that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll watch for screwdrivers or tape and bring them over if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Leo—thank you. I’ll keep you posted if we still need anything else before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: It’s at my front porch this Saturday. If you can help, I’d really appreciate it—I'm still pulling together a few folks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks for the reminder — I can stop by the front porch Saturday and help out if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would be a huge help, Noah — thank you. I’m still lining up a few folks, so I’d really appreciate you stopping by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—bring the list by and I’ll take another look in my shed. I may need a reminder, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren—that would be a big help. I’ll bring the list by so you can take another look in your shed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Mara—just bring it by when you can, and I’ll see what I’ve got in the shed. I may need that reminder, but I’m glad to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s coming together nicely. If you still need an extra set of hands or anything carried over, I can help later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — that’s really helpful. It’s now on Sunday at the community center, so I’ll let you know if we need anything carried over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Sunday at the community center — just let me know if you need an extra hand or anything hauled over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: It’s set up at the front porch, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the exact spot before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s at the front porch this Saturday. Thanks for checking—I’m still organizing helpers, so I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—front porch this Saturday. I’ll keep that in mind, and let me know if the spot or timing changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Cleo—if you can help set up the front porch tables and sort the repair items, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll set up the front porch tables and sort the repair items for Saturday. We should be all lined up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks, Cleo—I really appreciate it. See you Saturday at the front porch for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’ve got a good turnout, but I could still use a hand sorting tools and greeting folks at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help greet folks at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a huge help, Bo—thank you. If you can also point folks to the tool-sorting table, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Uli—just remember it’s Sunday at the community center now. If you’re heading over, bring what you can carry and we’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh—thanks for the heads-up. I’ll come by Sunday with what I can carry.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, much appreciated. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s the repair drive for tools, spare parts, and repair supplies, with drop-offs by the community hall. I’m spreading the word around the block and putting up a few invites too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate you spreading the word. Just a quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not the front porch, so please share that location change too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — Sunday at the community center now, not the front porch. I’ll spread that update around the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still short on a couple helpers, but I’ve got a few tools lined up. If you hear of anyone free Saturday, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can ask around and see if anyone’s free Saturday. Bring the list by and I’ll help however I can with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren—that’d really help. I’ll bring the list by later today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, that’s right—Sunday at the community center now. Thanks for checking, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll go with Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries—I'm organizing it this Saturday on the front porch, and we still need a few helpers. If you can pitch in, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help—what time should I come by Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s coming together nicely—folks are dropping off tools and spare parts, and I’m keeping an ear out for any last-minute updates.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great to hear—if you want, I can help keep people posted and point any extra helpers your way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Jules—please do! If you hear of anyone with tools or a free hand this Saturday, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need a few more hands, but we’re set for this Saturday on the front porch. People should bring items there and I’ll help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll send you the remaining fixes for the repair drive soon, so you can plan once everything’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, send them over when you can — I’ll keep lining up a few more helpers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could use a few people to sort tools and set up the front porch on Saturday. Can you help?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I can help sort tools and set up. Could you remind me what time we’re starting, and where people should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Pia — let’s start at 10 AM, and have folks drop things off at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the exact drop-off spot yet—do you know where it’s set up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — it’s set up at my front porch this Saturday. I’ll have the tools and drop-off spot ready for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’ll spread the word that the drop-off is at your front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it drew a good crowd—did you end up getting all the helpers you needed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not quite—I’m still trying to confirm the exact location, though it’s supposed to be at the front porch this Saturday. If you’re free, I could still use a helper or two.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help out—I’ll swing by the front porch this Saturday and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—has the repair drive time and front-porch drop-off spot been confirmed yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ve been a bit out of it, but I can help if there’s anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—just to confirm, we’re still set for Saturday at the front porch, right? If you can bring a box or tape, that’d help.
